note: Measured gate-lane wall clock on successful CI. Read by tools/gate-duration.mjs; CI fails when a lane exceeds the committed baseline by more than maxFactor. Re-measure before changing a baseline; do not hand-edit a number just to make CI green. Each lane's seconds are for the runner class named by cpus (GitHub's 4-CPU standard runner for public repositories); byCpus holds measurements on other classes, such as the 2-CPU runner a private repository gets (#1947). A class with no measurement is reported, not judged.

batch.evidence: 2026-10-12 re-baseline for #1351, which widened gate 7 (clauses) from 12 serial runs to an 80-run mean fanned over the bounded gate workers. Hosted measurements of the exact change: PR check run 38188378911 (d57d4922, 12/12 batch gates) measured 8.4m in tools/gate-duration.mjs; native merge-group run 38190129301 (68d8e76f, 12/12 batch gates, otherwise green) measured 8.8m and was refused only by the 1.25x guard on the old 7.0m baseline. Batch jobs on the same lane immediately before the change took about 7.5m end to end (PR #1292 check run 38165659035; main merge-group run 38189632987), so the growth is attributable to gate 7, about +1.3m on hosted runners against +0.5m measured on a four-core container. Budget rounded to 9.0m (540s); maxFactor 1.25 = 11.25m guard. Previous baseline: 7.0m (420s) from 2026-10-08 runs 37732468827 and 37733144405 after #439. Sources: https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/38188378911 ; https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/38190129301. Refs #1351, #334.

All preserve the full 800x500 sample and pass event/vocabulary reach. Whole nightly workflows also had unrelated slow-test failures; only their successful fire-rate jobs are timing evidence. The Oct 20 scheduled run 39394320348, job 118533182603, SHA e99904d94a6d92e9d46e0f6797874f3df64a7dd9, artifact 12251851723, is retained but excluded from this host-class mean: AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor / 4 CPUs / same Node, 561.401s (total 561.402s), 499 events, about 40% faster. A hypothetical 1.5x mean regression is 1395.894s / 23.2649m, exceeding 1162.5s and failing the exact CI guard. No sample, assertion or other lane changes. Full run/job/artifact/host evidence, outlier rationale and exact guard checks: docs/BALANCE-LOG.md, 2026-10-21 #1823.
